source_metadata.title: Guideline-as-Oracle: Zero-Annotation Training of an Ophthalmic Telephone Triage Agent

atoms.canonical_statement: The study evaluated whether an author-compiled ophthalmic guideline table could provide all instance-level labels needed to train a multi-turn telephone triage agent.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: what does it take to compile such a rule table into supervision

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors compiled American Academy of Ophthalmology-informed guidance into a 70-row operational triage table.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: expanded an initial 64-row AAO-informed table ... to m = 70

atoms.canonical_statement: Each generated profile cited a nonempty rule-row set and inherited the most severe tier among the cited rows.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: inherits the most severe tier among them

atoms.canonical_statement: The primary training corpus contained 3,000 synthetic multi-turn dialogues with a median of 11 nurse turns.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 3,000 dialogues with a median of 11 nurse turns

atoms.canonical_statement: The 3,000-dialogue corpus contained 625 emergent, 746 urgent, and 1,629 routine dialogues.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 625 emergent, 746 urgent, and 1,629 routine

atoms.canonical_statement: Class-weighted resampling with weights 2.0, 1.5, and 1.0 produced 3,998 training exposures.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Resampling with class weights 2.0, 1.5, and 1.0 yields 3,998 exposures

atoms.canonical_statement: The GAO-Triage intervention was full-parameter supervised fine-tuning of a 9B backbone for three epochs with nurse-token cross-entropy and caller-token masking.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: training runs for three epochs with nurse-token supervision and caller-token masking

exposures.details: Three epochs; nurse-token cross-entropy; caller-token masking

atoms.canonical_statement: The primary comparator was the untuned 9B backbone evaluated under the same clean protocol.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: pairs SFT against the untuned backbone in a same-day clean evaluation

atoms.canonical_statement: The internal evaluation benchmark comprised 201 public patient-authored ophthalmic Reddit narratives converted into interactive profiles.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 201 public, patient-authored ophthalmic Reddit narratives

atoms.canonical_statement: The operational reference included 42 emergent, 47 urgent, and 112 routine cases.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: leaving 42 emergent, 47 urgent, and 112 routine references

atoms.canonical_statement: GAO-Triage achieved 74.1% exact agreement with the operational reference versus 61.7% for the untuned 9B backbone.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Agreement rises from 61.7% to 74.1%

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 42 emergent-reference cases, GAO-Triage recall was 69.0% versus 9.5% for the untuned 9B backbone.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: emergent recall ... moving from 9.5% to 69.0%

population.label: Emergent-reference cases in the internal benchmark

atoms.canonical_statement: Severe under-triage decreased descriptively from 24 cases with the base model to 17 cases with GAO-Triage.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Severe under-triage falls from 24 to 17 cases

atoms.canonical_statement: A second same-recipe random seed achieved 73.1% agreement and 78.6% emergent recall.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: rerun, seed 2

atoms.canonical_statement: Under a second patient simulator, emergent recall was 71.4% for GAO-Triage versus 7.1% for the base model.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 71.4% versus 7.1%

population.label: Emergent-reference cases in the internal benchmark

atoms.canonical_statement: Permuting dialogue-label assignments collapsed the model to routine predictions for all 201 cases, with 55.7% agreement and 0% emergent and urgent recall.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Routine for every case—agreement 112/201=55.7%, recall 0/42

atoms.canonical_statement: Outcome-GRPO achieved 45.3% agreement and ended without a disposition in 80 of 201 dialogues.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Agreement falls to 45.3% ... 39.8% of dialogues end with no disposition

atoms.canonical_statement: Providing the 70-row rule table to GPT-5.5 yielded 67.7% agreement versus 75.1% without the table.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: given the rule table

atoms.canonical_statement: Removing or replacing the 160 tagged one-fact boundary dialogues changed agreement by at most 2 of 201 cases.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: moves agreement by at most 2 of 201 cases

atoms.canonical_statement: On Oxford-40, a trained precursor achieved 62.5% agreement, the untuned backbone 50.0%, and GPT-5.5 82.5%.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 62.5% and 50.0%, while zero-shot GPT-5.5 reaches 82.5%

atoms.canonical_statement: Approximately 19% of earlier rationale fields asserted findings that the caller had not supplied.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: roughly 19% of earlier Reason fields asserted findings the caller never supplied

atoms.canonical_statement: A later grounding sweep removed 222 dialogues and generated 219 label-matched replacements, leaving three removed without replacement.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: removed 222 dialogues and regenerated 219 label-matched replacements

atoms.canonical_statement: Label repair neutralized 491 symptom-family/tier contradictions and corrected 91 dialogues with three mutually inconsistent labels.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: neutralized 491 dialogues ... corrected 91

atoms.canonical_statement: The 70-row operational policy was benchmark-informed, lacked independent clinician validation, and was not mapped to source passages.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: carries neither independent clinician validation nor a mapping to source passages

atoms.canonical_statement: The benchmark informed rule-table revision, corpus development, model selection, and reference adjudication, limiting the evaluation to policy conformance rather than held-out clinical generalization.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the benchmark informed Φ, which informed both adjudication and training

atoms.canonical_statement: Historical evaluation runs were invalidated because a complete-profile heuristic could overwrite model verdicts using hidden case data.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: silently overwrote both the final nurse turn and the stored disposition

atoms.canonical_statement: An exact-template audit across 5,427 historical case-runs found 19 to 44 overwritten cases per run.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: spanning 5,427 case-runs finds 19 to 44 overwritten cases per run

atoms.canonical_statement: Most comparisons relied on one random seed and one patient simulator, and the design was underpowered for paired differences below roughly 10 percentage points.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: differences below roughly 10 points go undetected at 80% power

atoms.canonical_statement: Known paraphrase clusters and lexical-overlap findings did not establish isolation or decontamination of training data from benchmark content.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: establish neither isolation nor decontamination

atoms.canonical_statement: The external Oxford-40 test was small, static rather than interactive, used differing prompts, and had a 57.5% constant-emergent baseline.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: a constant-emergent baseline already attains 57.5%

atoms.canonical_statement: The study retained no platform agreement, acquisition record, or de-identification audit for the public-post-derived data, and no IRB review was sought.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: retain no platform agreement, acquisition record, or de-identification audit

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that guideline compilation can substitute for per-instance annotation for policy-conformance training when annotated conversations are scarce.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: guideline compilation offers a practical alternative to per-instance annotation

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors stated that independent multi-clinician labels and an interactive external benchmark are prerequisites for a clinical claim.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: independent multi-clinician labels and an interactive external benchmark
